exposure: Women with sphincter interruption on TL-US
Women with third- or fourth-degree lacerations
outcome: Anal sphincter complex (ASC) measurements using 2D and 3D translabial ultrasound (TL-US)
finding: There were few differences in normative sphincter ultrasound measurements between primiparous patients who had VB or CD, with only IAS measurements at the proximal and distal 12 o'clock position being significantly thicker for CD patients.
mod_finding: IAS measurements at the proximal and distal 12 o'clock position were significantly thicker for women who had a Cesarean delivery compared to those who had a vaginal birth.
